critical_code_review_comments: server.py analytics langs aggregation uses match without type filter (line 380-383), so lang_switch events count toward lang totals. This is likely intentional (broader picture of visitor language preferences including toggles) but should be documented — the /devices/ aggregation restricts to type=pageview (line 375) which creates minor inconsistency in semantics.
TrackEvent model has no length cap on visitor_id in Pydantic; server-side truncation at [:64] (line 340) handles this — good defensive coding.
referrer host detection in analytics.js falls back to 'direct' on any URL parse failure (line 22) — sound.
Consent listener in App.js uses langRef.current so pageview after Terima captures current lang correctly — no stale-closure bug.
server.py is now 457 lines — close to 700-line threshold. Consider splitting analytics + auth into separate routers before further growth.
